Hebrew/Greek Contour Table App

Generate text

Choose Hebrew/WLC or Greek/SBLGNT, then generate into the editor.

SBLGNT source files are provided by Faithlife/SBLGNT under CC BY 4.0; Hebrew source remains the bundled WLC.

Paste text

Paste Hebrew/Greek text here. Each line becomes a verse/section.

Project save / restore

Autosave is on. Your work is saved in this browser automatically.

Click a word, then use Enter break clause, Tab indent, Backspace unindent/remove break, n note, t gloss, p predicate, s subject, Delete or Shift+Backspace hide/restore word, arrow keys navigate words/clauses.

Text color:
Word formatting:
Highlight:
Brackets: Tip: select a start word, then Shift-click the end word.
Arc connectors: Click Draw Arc, drag from one word to another, and release. Or use Set Arc Start/End.
Export Legend / Key

Create custom labels for the markings you use. These appear in the Word/PDF contour export.

Inclusio / Structural Markers

Use this to mark matching start/end phrases, like an inclusio. Select a word, set start, select the ending word, then set end.

Comments: For one word, select a word and click Add Comment. For multiple words, set a start word, select an end word, then Add Comment.

Table edits autosave as you type.

Input

Select a word, or set a start word then select an end word.
